items.text: A business valuation career involves estimating what a business or asset is worth for deals, disclosure, tax and disputes, using financial models, market comparisons and judgement, and it often sits in finance firms, consultancies and registered valuer roles with specific eligibility rules.
Learn financial statements and valuation methods, build two documented models and check official eligibility rules for registered valuer roles.
Proof you can show supports an earlier path to financial freedom.
